subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close the open cross-repo PR and queue a fresh narrow fix against the active Telegram approval runtime, or try to adopt that conflicting branch?
rationale: Automation should not open another fix while an open closing PR still exists, but the current linked branch is not a viable landing base without maintainer cleanup.

options.title: Close and replace
options.body: Close the conflicting cross-repo branch, then queue or accept a narrow PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the branch
options.body: A maintainer can try to salvage the open branch, but most of its current diff targets obsolete code and unrelated docs.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the open branch, accepting that the current source-level bug remains unresolved on main and in the latest release.

recommendation.title: Close and replace
recommendation.body: Close the conflicting cross-repo branch, then queue or accept a narrow PR against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the native approval lifecycle refactor that defines the current owner boundary for the fix.
